sequences.name: New signup onboarding (Day 0–30)
sequences.description: Lasker line: Your business sounds established from day one — and builds its credit while it does.

steps.name: Email 1 · Welcome
steps.subject: Welcome to Global Voice Direct — your business line is ready
steps.preview: Here is exactly what you bought, and the 3 things to do in your first 10 minutes.
steps.purpose: Activation: first login — Restate the purchase and the line; reason why: a dedicated business number keeps personal and business separate and makes a small company look establi
steps.body:
Hi {{first_name}},

Welcome to Global Voice Direct. You now have what most small businesses wait years to look like: a dedicated business phone line, with unlimited minutes included in your plan.

Why it matters: when a customer calls a business number and hears a professional greeting, they trust you before you say a word. When you call from your personal cell, they don't.

Your first 10 minutes:
1. Sign in to your account.
2. Open Phone numbers and confirm your business number.
3. Record your greeting so callers hear your company name.

Sign in to your account

We are a real business, with a real office at 165 Halsey St, Suite 106, and real people at (877) 308-5803. Reply to this email any time.

steps.name: Email 2 · Make it sound like a company
steps.subject: Step 1: make your number sound like a company
steps.preview: Record a greeting and set up your extensions in a few minutes.
steps.purpose: Activation: greeting + extension set up — Specific benefit with reason why: a greeting with your company name and menu makes a one-person shop sound like a staffed office.
steps.body:
Hi {{first_name}},

The first thing a caller hears decides whether they think you're a business or a side project. Record a greeting with your company name, and set extensions so calls reach the right person (even if that person is always you).

Record your greeting Then: Set up extensions

Your business sounds established from day one. This is the step that makes it true.

Your business number shouldn't be stuck at a desk. Install the mobile app (App Store or Google Play), then scan the sign-in QR on your Mobile app page. Calls show your business number, not your personal cell, so your private number stays private.

At your computer? Use the browser phone on the WebRTC page, no install needed.

steps.name: Email 5 · Build business credit
steps.subject: Your business can start building credit — here's how
steps.preview: Send your business credit application so your business is reported correctly.
steps.purpose: Retention: high-value differentiator — Big reason why to stay: the account itself works toward business credit; we report to business credit bureaus.
steps.body:
Hi {{first_name}},

Most phone bills do nothing for your business. Yours can. Global Voice Direct reports to business credit bureaus, and your account shows a $7,500 business credit line.

Why it matters: a business credit history that's separate from your personal credit is what lenders and suppliers look for when you want terms.

Step 1 is sending your business credit application so your information is reported correctly. The video shows how in a few minutes.

Start your credit application Watch how

(Approval and reporting depend on your application and account standing.)

steps.name: Email 6 · Fax without a machine
steps.subject: Fax from your phone or laptop — no machine
steps.preview: Your fax service is part of your account. Here's how to turn it on.
steps.purpose: Feature adoption: fax — Concrete benefit: no machine, no second line; from any device.
steps.body:
Hi {{first_name}},

Banks, insurers, government offices and medical offices still ask for faxes. You don't need a machine or another phone line, because your Global Voice Direct account sends and receives faxes from any device.

Send your first fax Watch: Start your fax service

steps.name: Email 9 · First month recap
steps.subject: What your first month built for your business
steps.preview: A recap of what's working, and what to do next to keep building.
steps.purpose: Conversion/renewal: keep paying — Summarize value delivered; reason to stay: credit history builds with time, numbers customers know shouldn't change.
steps.body:
Hi {{first_name}},

In one month your business got a dedicated number with unlimited minutes, a professional greeting, calls on your phone and laptop, fax from any device, and a path to business credit.

Why staying matters: your customers now know your number, and business credit history grows with every month your account stays current. Changing providers resets both.

Your business sounds established — keep building on it.

Go to your account
